description_en: Modifies the maintenance window or description of a specified ApsaraDB for SelectDB instance
description_zh: 修改指定云数据库SelectDB版实例的运维时间或备注信息
kebab_example: aliyun selectdb modify-db-instance-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id selectdb-cn-7213cjv0000 --instance-attribute-type DBInstanceDescription --value testdb01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBInstanceAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The attribute to modify. Valid values:

MaintainTime: Modifies the maintenance window. The format is hh:mm-hh:mm.

DBInstanceDescription: Modifies the instance description
parameters.help_zh:
修改项，取值说明：

MaintainTime：修改运维时间，格式为hh:mm-hh:mm。

DBInstanceDescription：修改实例备注
parameters.name: instance_attribute_type

parameters.help_en:
The new value for the attribute. Valid values:

If InstanceAttributeType is set to MaintainTime, you can set this parameter to a value such as 00:00-06:00.

If InstanceAttributeType is set to DBInstanceDescription, you can set this parameter to a value such as testdb
parameters.help_zh:
修改内容。取值说明：

当InstanceAttributeType为MaintainTime时，您可以取值为00:00-06:00。

当InstanceAttributeType为DBInstanceDescription时，您可以取值为testdb
parameters.name: value
